extra.final_summary: Found and fixed three data issues affecting the question. First, island names had case and space variants (e.g., 'torgersen', 'Dream ') which were normalized to match the rules file using trim_whitespace. Second, body_mass_g was stored as text with commas; it was safely converted to numeric. Third, three rows (46, 47, 63) had impossible negative flipper lengths (-215, -228, -198) far outside the valid range [170, 235]; these were excluded. After these fixes, the average flipper length per species was computed: Adelie: 190.18 mm, Chinstrap: 199.64 mm, Gentoo: 215.14 mm.
